name: Crystal Charge
label: Quest
description: Crystal Charge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Pylon table allows you to combine red power crystals with yellow power crystals.
According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to create a large explosion that can inflict damage on your enemies.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Arranging the crystals on the table, you carefully align the colors. As you push the last one into place, a burst of light fuses the crystals together.
The resulting combination is now yours.
